title: Spanish Basics
description: Learn fundamental Spanish vocabulary and grammar

questions.question: How do you say 'Hello' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Hola means 'hello' or 'hi' in Spanish. It's the most common greeting used in Spanish-speaking countries.

questions.question: What does 'Gracias' mean?
questions.explanation: Gracias means 'thank you' in Spanish. It's used to express gratitude, just like in English.

questions.question: How do you say 'Good morning' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Buenos días means 'good morning' in Spanish. It's used as a greeting typically until noon or early afternoon.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'water'?
questions.explanation: Agua means 'water' in Spanish. Note that although agua is feminine (el agua), it uses the article 'el' because it starts with a stressed 'a'.

questions.question: How do you say 'My name is...' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Me llamo... (literally 'I call myself...') is the most common way to introduce yourself in Spanish. You can also say 'Mi nombre es...' (My name is...).

questions.question: What does 'Por favor' mean?
questions.explanation: Por favor means 'please' in Spanish. It's an important phrase for polite requests and is used similarly to English.

questions.question: How do you say 'Yes' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Sí means 'yes' in Spanish. Note the accent mark (í) which distinguishes it from 'si' (if).

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'house'?
questions.explanation: Casa means 'house' or 'home' in Spanish. It's a feminine noun, so you say 'la casa'.

questions.question: How do you say 'Goodbye' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Adiós means 'goodbye' in Spanish. You can also use 'Hasta luego' (see you later) or 'Hasta pronto' (see you soon).

questions.question: What does '¿Cómo estás?' mean?
questions.explanation: ¿Cómo estás? means 'How are you?' in Spanish (informal). The formal version is '¿Cómo está usted?'.
